episode.title: 30 AI Companies Shaping the Future
episode.source_line: Sources: company releases, Bloomberg, TechCrunch, Caixin, exchanges
episode.scope_note: 30 well-known AI-native companies (language, image, video, voice & music, coding, search, robotics), listed by founding year, not ranked. Value = latest completed private round (post-money), market cap for listed companies (close of Nov 3, 2026 unless dated otherwise), or the acquisition price for companies bought by others. Where no recent valuation exists, the card says what the number is (raised / ARR / share sale / pre-money). Flags show headquarters country. Sources for every number are listed below.

items.name: Google DeepMind
items.subtitle: London, UK

source.name: Google DeepMind / Alphabet (acquired by Google 26 Jan 2014)

items.notes: Subsidiary: no standalone valuation. Merged with Google Brain Apr 2023. Research reports Hassabis moved to chair + Alphabet chief scientist in Aug 2026 (single source) — confirmed by independent QC (several sources): role shown as 'Co-founder & Chair'. [QC 2026-11-04 independent fact-check: qc_data_independent.md]

items.name: Cohere

items.notes: Sources differ >10%: Bloomberg 'over $20B' vs BetaKit C$35.7B post-money (~$25.5B). Independent QC found Cohere's own release (2026-10-29) states C$35.7B post-money (assuming the full C$7B is raised), so the card now shows the company's figure in CAD (≈US$25.5B), as Mistral shows euros; Bloomberg's 'over $20B' likely refers to another basis. Series E only at initial close. Aleph Alpha merger signed 2026-09-16, not yet closed → badge MERGER PENDING. Founded 2019 (month unknown). items.notes: Acquired by SpaceX 2026-02-02 (all-stock); rebranded SpaceXAI (Jul 2026), Musk said 2026-10-04 it will become SpaceXSI (effective date unknown). insights.text: Hugging Face began as a chatbot app for teenagers before becoming the hub for AI models.
Next: Cohere. Its CEO co-wrote 'Attention Is All You Need', the 2017 Transformer paper.
Midjourney never took outside money. Meta licensed its tech instead (Aug 2025).
Fears over DeepSeek-R1 wiped about $589B off Nvidia's value in one day (Jan 27, 2025).
Google owns DeepMind, SpaceX owns xAI and Cursor, and Nvidia is buying Hugging Face.
